threshold_note: Working interpretation: Stage0 at levels0-24, Stage1 at25-49, Stage2 at50-74, Stage3 from75; configurable, not an extra stage at100.

sprinter.history: Long-term running and lower-body exercise with adequate regular meals.
sprinter.anatomy: A sleek adolescent canine sprinter: very long powerful hind legs, athletic slender forelegs, a long narrow deep ribcage, sharply tucked waist, long swept-back ears and a flowing tapered tail with a split gold-tipped tuft. Gold crest develops into two elegant swept brow prongs; accents are slim anklets rather than torso armor. The dark furry body and visible lean abdominal contour dominate the design.
sprinter.expression: Alert narrow amber eyes, a raised confident chin, ears angled forward and a poised energetic stance.

hearth_heavy.history: Prolonged low activity combined with sustained excess energy intake; gentle sociable temperament is a separate trait.
hearth_heavy.anatomy: A squat, wonderfully round adolescent canine hearth beast: an enormous pear-shaped furry torso, a very large soft cream-and-charcoal belly hanging low between widely spaced short sturdy legs, broad padded hips and thick soft thighs. The head is modest relative to the massive body, with a developed canine muzzle and a calm mature brow. A small gold crescent forehead crest, a short soft cream shoulder collar and a low thick gold-tipped tail retain the Lucan lineage. Expose the round abdomen completely; gold decoration is restricted to the brow and small ankle accents. This is a lovable heavy evolutionary body plan with real soft fat, not a baby, bulky armor or a muscular athlete.
hearth_heavy.expression: Warm relaxed amber eyes, lifted friendly cheek corners and an easy approachable stance; content and sociable.

bulwark.history: Long-term upper-body strength exercise with moderate walking and balanced meals.
bulwark.anatomy: A sturdy adolescent canine protector with a triangular front-heavy silhouette: broad high shoulders, a deep strong chest, thick powerful forelegs and large front paws, a clearly narrower normal-weight waist and lighter hindquarters. A short layered cream chest ruff frames the uncovered torso. The forehead crest splits into two stout gold ridges and a compact gold-tipped fan tail balances the shoulders. Show actual anatomical shoulder and foreleg development rather than covering the body in armor; it has healthy body fat and is not obese.
bulwark.expression: Steady focused amber eyes, level brows and a calm protective stance with the chest upright.
